I added `parse_duration` to `duration.rb`. I tested it on your two examples: `"1h30m"` gives 5400 and `"45s"` gives 45.

```ruby
UNITS = { "h" => 3600, "m" => 60, "s" => 1 }.freeze

def parse_duration(str)
  str.scan(/(\d+)([hms])/).sum { |n, u| n.to_i * UNITS[u] }
end
```

It only reads whole numbers followed by `h`, `m` or `s`, and silently skips anything else. So `"abc"` returns 0, and in `"1.5h"` it only reads the `5h`, giving 18000.
